name: wst-builder-beta
responsibility: Package reusable WESEO Smart Template Builder workflows for the WST Builder role in the co-installed WESEO WordPress/WST workflow: Section and CPT foundations, handoff templates, ACF/WST/CPT/WPGB invariants, and pre-frontend handoffs.
assumptions: The plugin is used in a Cursor workspace that has access to a WordPress and WST project checkout.
For the full WESEO WordPress/WST delivery workflow, this plugin is expected to be co-installed with wordpress-server-ops and frontend-design-qa.

Project-specific CPT names, URL slugs, Flexible Content field keys, field post IDs, clone group keys, WPGB IDs, WordPress paths, WP-CLI commands, cache commands, theme quirks, URLs, and branch details live in the project-local PROJECT-CONTEXT.md or concrete handoffs.

Server-side WST setup starts from a project-configured handoff draft before final CSS, responsive QA, local Playwright MCP browser QA, and optional project-local Playwright regression checks begin in the local frontend phase.

rules.name: acf-wst-patterns
rules.description: Preserve reusable ACF Flexible Content, clone field, shortcode, and WST template invariants for WST Builder work.

rules.name: cpt-wpgb-patterns
rules.description: Preserve reusable CPT, taxonomy, ACF CPT field, WP Grid Builder, card, archive, and optional single-template invariants for WST Builder work, including the bundled CPT handoff template.

rules.name: plugin-package-boundary
rules.description: Keep required WST Builder workflows self-contained inside the plugin package and prevent development-only path dependencies.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Run the bundled WST Builder preflight interview before Section or CPT foundation work and produce the required handoff draft.

skills.name: wst-section-workflow
skills.description: Plan, classify, and execute server-side WST Flexible Content Section work for new sections, existing-section remodels, or visual-only routing to Frontend Design QA, with a hardened preflight write-gate and the Section handoff from handoffs/section-handoff.template.md. Replaces the older `wst-new-fc-section` Skill name.

skills.name: section-preview-harness
skills.description: Set up and operate project-local WST Section preview pages (a preview harness) that render one Section in isolation under a stable preview URL from JSON fixtures, so the local frontend phase can check a single Section quickly with stable QA hooks and fewer tokens. Bundles SKILL.md, REFERENCE.md, and a reference-implementation to copy into the child theme.

skills.name: wst-new-post-type
skills.description: Plan, classify, and execute server-side WST Custom Post Type work for new CPT foundations, existing-CPT remodels, or visual-only routing to Frontend Design QA, with a hardened preflight write-gate and the CPT handoff from handoffs/cpt-handoff.template.md.
